description: addon-ssl (server cert at /certs root, used by the test settings.js HTTPS) + addon-mtls (client cert at /certs/mtls/node-red/). Verifies the client cert exists at /certs/mtls/node-red/cert.pem (default mtls.check_file_paths) AND that addon-mtls's scoped chown of the mtls/ subdir does not clobber the SSL server certs at the certs-volume root (node-red would fail to start otherwise). node-red is not auto-configured — manual flow wiring is documented in application.md (## addon-mtls).
